_note: Shared robots.txt cases run by BOTH the Python worker suite and the TypeScript web suite. The report and the public checker must give a site the same answer, so the two implementations are pinned to the same expectations here rather than trusted to stay in step.

cases.name: the agent's own group beats the wildcard
tokens match exactly, never as a substring
Allow wins when both govern the root
a path-level Disallow does not block the site
consecutive user-agent lines share one group
comments are ignored
cases.robots:
# nope
User-agent: * # everyone
Disallow: / # all of it

cases.name: rules before any user-agent line apply to nothing
the real split policy: in the answers, out of the training
cases.robots:
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /
